product_brief: Ledger SDK implementation of ML-KEM and ML-DSA for quantum-resistant key exchange and signatures on embedded devices.
pqc_capability_description: Implements ML-KEM (FIPS 203) for key encapsulation and ML-DSA (FIPS 204) for digital signatures. Optimized for constrained hardware (Ledger devices) with low-RAM techniques. Output is bit-for-bit identical to NIST reference. Current version lacks side-channel countermeasures (planned for v2).
crypto_primitives: ML-KEM, ML-DSA, ECDSA, ECDH, RSA, SHA3-256, SHA3-512, SHAKE-128, SHAKE-256, AES
key_management_model: Secure Element-backed key generation and storage on Ledger hardware devices; programmatic API for key pair generation, encapsulation, decapsulation, signing, and verification.
latest_version: V1 (implied by "NO SIDE-CHANNEL COUNTERMEASURES IN V1")
fips_validated: No (Implements FIPS 203/204 standards; output matches NIST test vectors, but no FIPS 140 validation status stated)
primary_platforms: Ledger Nano X, Ledger Nano S Plus, Ledger Flex, Ledger Stax, Ledger Nano Gen5
pqc_roadmap_details: Future v2 will add side-channel countermeasures including shuffling (random permutation of polynomial operations) and arithmetic masking.
implementation_attack_surface: Current V1 lacks hardware countermeasures against fault injection and side-channel attacks (e.g., arithmetic masking, execution shuffling). Constant-time comparison and sensitive zeroization are implemented.
testing_&_validation_methods: Bit-for-bit identical output to NIST reference test vectors.
constrained_device_&_iot_suitability: Highly suitable for constrained embedded systems; optimized for stack usage <16kB on Ledger secure elements using row-by-row matrix expansion and on-the-fly polynomial recomputation.
